business_problem: GreenFlex needed a simpler way to govern and share rapidly growing energy-consumption data across disconnected workspaces and storage buckets without slowing analytics, machine learning or audit readiness.
solution_summary: GreenFlex modernized its energy-data environment on the Databricks Data + AI Platform so terabytes of customer IoT consumption data could be governed and reused across exploration, business intelligence and machine learning. Before the change, development, staging and production each wrote data to separate local metastores and AWS S3 buckets, making permissions and data availability difficult to manage. With Unity Catalog, GreenFlex now uses a single metastore across workspaces, defines SQL-based access policies once at the account level and applies centralized audit controls across teams. Delta Lake complements that design with Bronze-to-Gold refinement, time travel and better query performance over partitioned datasets. The unified setup lets developers create and share new tables faster, cuts onboarding from about a week to minutes, and gives energy-efficiency teams a governed foundation for anomaly detection and sustainability analytics.

data_flow: Customer energy-consumption and IoT data is ingested into Databricks and stored in Delta Lake, where GreenFlex refines it from Bronze to Gold tables for exploration, BI and machine learning. Unity Catalog governs access to the shared datasets across development, staging and production workspaces from one central metastore.
business_outcome: GreenFlex reduced access-management work from days to minutes, cut onboarding from about a week to a few minutes, improved query performance over terabytes of energy data and gave teams more time to focus on sustainability analytics instead of manual governance tasks.

evidence_quotes: GreenFlex leverages the Databricks Data + AI Platform to ingest terabytes of IoT data, and perform analytics and machine learning on the energy consumption data collected from its customers.
Unity Catalog helped GreenFlex simplify access management by providing a single pane of glass to manage access permissions using familiar and standardized SQL.
Together with Unity Catalog, Delta Lake unlocked numerous pain points we had, dramatically improving the performance of queries over terabytes of data, enabling data access auditing and time travel.
This has accelerated the company's ability to onboard new employees and grant access to data from about a week to a few minutes.
GreenFlex data administrators can now achieve that in minutes while fully mastering the impact of changes.
